channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Fried, Rabbi Smotrich, and the minister lead thousands in joyous dancing | Watch
item.description: Rabbi Yerucham Smotrich and his son, Minister Bezalel Smotrich, dance alongside Avraham Fried at the International Convention Center in Jerusalem.

item.title: Likud primaries: May Golan and Amit Halevi demand freeze on Yeruham vote count
item.description:
Minister May Golan and Member of Knesset Amit Halevi have submitted urgent complaints to the Likud party’s Central Election Committee, alleging severe forgery during the vote counting at the polling station in Yeruham.
The two are demanding an immediate halt to the counting process at the site, pointing to repeated incidents of erasures, alterations, and marking of votes that did not match the names of the candidates actually being read aloud.

item.title: Trump rules out extending Iran framework agreement
item.description: President Trump declares he will not extend the framework deal with Iran, while maintaining the US holds "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Footage from Qabatiya | Duvdevan Unit thwarts terror attacks, arrests wanted suspects
item.description: In a targeted operation, IDF searches roughly 100 structures and detains suspects. Simultaneously, elite Duvdevan unit apprehends two wanted individuals suspected of planning and executing terror attacks.

item.title: Jews who funded Zohran Mamdani and Mahmoud Khalil
item.description: Forty-four percent of American Jews view Mamdani favorably. That did not happen organically. It is due to the work of a progressive Jewish infrastructure funded by Diaspora liberal Jews. Report.

item.title: Kushner: Hamas has 60-90 days to hand over weapons
item.description: President Trump's envoy and son-in-law says concerns raised by Netanyahu during four-hour meeting were addressed, stresses Israel will retain right to defend itself. On Hamas: 'We’re going to give them a chance to perform.'

item.title: ZOA President: Spielberg Foundation funding of anti-Israel groups 'despicable, shameful'
item.description: Morton Klein condemns grants from Steven Spielberg's Righteous Persons Foundation to progressive Jewish organizations critical of Israel, saying profits from Schindler's List are being used to support groups that endanger Jews.

item.title: The new directive IDF troops in Gaza received
item.description: Following meetings between the Prime Minister and Trump administration envoys, troops in the Gaza Strip have officially been prohibited from continuing to expand the area under Israeli control.

item.title: Israeli teams search collapsed building as mission to Colombia enters third day
item.description: Israeli rescuers are working alongside Colombian teams at a six-story building collapse site in Cali, while engineers assess wider structural damage following a powerful earthquake.

item.title: Six yeshiva of Sderot guardians never came home
item.description: For 30 years they guarded this city. Now almost $300,000 prevents their yeshiva from finishing what they started.

item.title: Murdered soldier's father slams intelligence unit commander
item.description: The father of fallen surveillance soldier Roni Eshel published a painful post against Brig. Gen. Yossi Sariel, who commanded Unit 8200 on October 7.

item.title: Special: From Hamas tunnels to Jewish Gaza
item.description: Former hostage Yosef Haim Ohana visits the Gush Katif Museum and reflects on Jewish life in Gaza, his captivity, and an emotional mitzvah with his father.

item.title: Four-year-old boy killed in traffic accident in Beit Shemesh
item.description: A four-year-old boy was critically injured after being struck by a car in Beit Shemesh. Magen David Adom teams dispatched to the scene performed resuscitation efforts, but were ultimately forced to pronounce him dead.

item.title: Scottish venue admits discriminating against Jewish comedian
item.description: An Edinburgh venue admits it unlawfully discriminated against Jewish comedian Philip Simon after cancelling his Fringe show over his views on Israel and Gaza.

item.title: Child injured in stabbing declared dead
item.description: One of the two children who were stabbed in Beit Shemesh has been declared dead.

item.title: The three words my son refused to whisper
item.description: I heard my 11-year-old son Eli shouting across an otherwise tranquil resort pool: “AM YISRAEL CHAI!" Loudly, very loudly. And at first, I was worried.

item.title: Netanyahu, Board of Peace agree to establish 2 working groups for Gaza peace plan
item.description: The Prime Minister's Office stated: "The Prime Minister and Board of Peace had deep and constructive discussions. It was agreed to establish two working groups, one on disarmament and demilitarisation of Gaza, which both Israel and the Board of Peace are determined should be prompt and completed before any reconstruction happens in Gaza. A second working group will focus on sanitation, clean water and other public health issues for the people of Gaza and which also impact the people of Israel."

item.title: Central Synagogue was attacked during Shabbat
item.description: Another antisemitic attack on American Jews at prayer. This one happened inside the most politically connected Reform synagogue in the country, a place where Israel has been condemned.

item.title: Kushner warns Netanyahu to 'not create obstacles'
item.description: In 4-hour meeting with Israeli PM, US envoy Jared Kushner presses Israel to implement the 15-point Gaza peace plan.

item.title: Herzog to Kushner: Next stages in Gaza must guarantee Israel's security
item.description: President Isaac Herzog meets Jared Kushner and Nickolay Mladenov in Jerusalem, stresses Israel's security must remain central to Gaza plan.

item.title: Peru: Israeli man dies after years of imprisonment
item.description:
A 62-year-old Israeli citizen, a resident of Petah Tikva, died in Peru after being imprisoned in the country for about three and a half years.
Upon receiving the report, ZAKA's international unit began working together with the Foreign Ministry, the family, and local authorities in Peru, with the aim of arranging all the necessary procedures and bringing his coffin for burial in Israel.

item.title: Liberman lays out coalition red lines ahead of Israeli elections
item.description: Yisrael Beytenu Chairman Avigdor Liberman sets coalition red lines, ruling out a minority government and demanding military or civilian service for all Israelis.

item.description: As government pushes core curriculum, severe teacher shortage prompting haredi leaders to confront deeper problem.

item.title: Joyous news: Widow of murdered soldier Elhanan Klein remarries
item.description: Hanan Breuer, who lost his wife Mor shortly after the birth of their son, and Hila Klein, the widow of Elhanan Klein, who was murdered in a terrorist attack, have built a new home together.

item.title: No single official can decide what Jewish children learn
item.description: Who gave one unelected official, Gali Baharav-Miara, this much power? Opinion.

item.title: Senior Iranian official: 'Iran is moving from defense to completely offensive'
item.description:
A senior Iranian official threatened that Iran has decided to shift its policy from defensive to "completely offensive," Reuters reported.
The official claimed that Iran has set a deadline of several weeks for the US to fully enforce the memorandum of understanding. "All Iranian entities are ready to escalate tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and the region if diplomacy fails. Iran's timetable will be conveyed to the US through intermediary countries. Iran will not wait for the US to continue its naval blockade forever."
